hotel_name: Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel

claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Brera, just steps from Teatro alla Scala.

findings.quote: Just steps from Teatro alla Scala, Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan captures the city’s spirit in the heart of Brera.

claims.text: It is a two-minute walk to both Teatro alla Scala and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.

findings.quote: just a few steps from the Teatro alla Scala and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
it’s a two-minute walk to both

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the fashion district and Via Montenapoleone.

findings.quote: Within walking distance of the renowned fashion district and upscale Via Montenapoleone

claims.text: The building's exterior is a Rationalist landmark by architect Pietro Lingeri.

findings.quote: Casa Brera’s exterior by Pietro Lingeri, crafts a Rationalist landmark within the neighborhood.

claims.text: Patricia Urquiola designed the hotel's interiors.

findings.quote: Patricia Urquiola’s vibrant interiors tell a different story

claims.text: The interiors include Cassina and Poliform furniture and locally sourced marble.

findings.quote: From artworks inspired by fashion, theatre and design to Cassina and Poliform furniture, as well as locally sourced marble

claims.text: The art collection includes pieces by Tim Walker and Carolina Mizrahi alongside local emerging talent.

findings.quote: pieces from legends such as Tim Walker and Carolina Mizrahi, sit side-by-side with local emerging talent

claims.text: Each en-suite bathroom is made of locally sourced streaked marble, with sleek black fixtures and Etro products.

findings.quote: Fashioned from locally sourced streaked marble, each en-suite bathroom is a luxurious sanctuary, where glossy surfaces, sleek black fixtures and Etro products add a further touch of Italian sophistication.

claims.text: Etereo, the sky bar and restaurant, is on the eighth and top floor.

findings.quote: The sky bar and restaurant Etereo await you on the 8th and top floor

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Studio connects adjoining guestrooms for up to four guests traveling together.

findings.quote: An inspired option for up to four guests traveling together, the Two Bedroom Studio is formed by connecting adjoining guestrooms

claims.text: The Luxury Collection Concierge can arrange a vintage Fiat 500, theatre tickets or a personal shopping experience.

findings.quote: hiring a vintage Fiat 500, securing coveted theatre tickets, or arranging a personal shopping experience

claims.text: The rooftop terrace has a restaurant, an outdoor pool and city views.

findings.quote: Casa Brera’s singular rooftop terrace features a destination restaurant, outdoor pool and limitless city views.

claims.text: The Brera and Milanese Suites have a separate master bedroom and living room, each opening onto a large terrace with bespoke seating and lush planting; the Milanese Suite's terrace looks across to the Duomo di Milano.

findings.quote: can choose to stay in the Brera or Milanese Suites, furnished with separate master bedroom and living room, each opening onto a large terrace, fashioned with bespoke seating, lush planting and impressive views
it offers exceptional views across to Duomo di Milano

claims.text: Patricia Urquiola restored the historic 1950s rationalist building by architect Pietro Lingeri.

findings.quote: Patricia Urquiola has carried out a careful restoration of the historic 1950s rationalist building by architect Pietro Lingeri

claims.text: From Etereo, diners look out to landmarks including the Duomo di Milano, Teatro alla Scala, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and Castello Sforzesco.

findings.quote: diners benefit from the immediacy of iconic landmarks, including Duomo di Milano, Teatro alla Scala, Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Castello Sforzesco and more

claims.text: The Seasons of Brera walking tours start at the hotel and change with the time of year.

findings.quote: The Seasons of Brera Destination Discovery features walking tours tailored to the time of year. Commencing at Casa Brera

claims.text: Brera's cobblestone streets can be challenging in high heels.

findings.quote: The cobblestone streets may be challenging if you’re in stilettos

claims.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.

findings.quote: Minimum Age to Check In: 18
On-site valet parking is available at Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan.
